notesStmt.note: The postmarks on the verso of this manuscript are dated August 1889, and it was in those months (the summer and fall of 1889) that Whitman was first conceiving of what he called "the annex to the annex" of Leaves of Grass (the first annex being "Sands at Seventy," the poems that had appeared in November Boughs in 1888). This manuscript was therefore likely composed in 1889 or 1890.

This manuscript, written on the back of an envelope, is possibly an early trial title for the volume that would become Good-Bye My Fancy (1891). The subtitle for that volume was 2d Annex to Leaves of Grass.
